Apple has announced September 9 as the date for its iPhone launch event, with the tagline "Awe dropping." Below is how to watch the September event live, along with a look at the new products rumored to make their debut.

iPhone 18 Pro "Awe dropping" Launch Event: How to Watch the September 9 Livestream

Apple has set the date for its most important event of the year — one that also officially kicks off the era of John Ternus as CEO.

The iPhone 18 Pro launch event will take place on September 9 at 1 p.m. ET / 10 a.m. PT.

The press has been invited to an in-person viewing event at Apple Park, but the launch will also be live-streamed online to a global audience. As has been Apple's custom in recent years, it is expected to be delivered as a pre-recorded video.

You can watch the September "Awe dropping" event through the following methods:

  • Via this livestream link on Apple's official YouTube channel
  • On the Apple TV app on any device
  • On Apple's official event webpage

What new products will the September event unveil? iPhone 18 Pro, iPhone Ultra, new Apple Watch models, and more

Apple is expected to roll out a slew of new products at its September 9 event. Here's everything rumored to be making an appearance:

iPhone

  • iPhone 18 Pro: Major camera upgrades, A20 Pro processor, new color options, updated Dynamic Island, and more
  • iPhone 18 Pro Max: Larger battery capacity, potentially exclusive camera feature
  • iPhone Ultra: The first foldable model

Apple Watch

  • Apple Watch Series 12: Upgraded S-series chip, more health features
  • Apple Watch Ultra 4: New health sensors, refreshed design, and more

AirPods

  • AirPods 5: New models with and without Active Noise Cancellation (ANC)
  • No camera-equipped model, contrary to earlier leaks

Home products

  • All-new Apple TV 4K: Apple Intelligence support, Siri AI
  • HomePad: Smart home hub
  • HomePod mini 2: Upgraded processor with Siri AI support

Among all the rumored new products, iPhone and Apple Watch models are the safest bets. The September event has traditionally centered on these two major product lines. However, according to Mark Gurman, AirPods 5 and new home products also appear quite likely to make an appearance.

If all of the above products debut on September 9, it would be a very high-profile "debut" launch for new CEO John Ternus.

Which product are you most looking forward to seeing at Apple's September event — the iPhone 18 Pro, iPhone Ultra, or something else? Let us know in the comments.
